title: RentCompass held-out benchmark case (hard-constraint schema v2)
description: One held-out task-benchmark case. v2 replaces the OVERLOADED room_type_match of v1 (which carried both a room-type label and a bedroom count, discriminated by re.match(r'\d+') on the value) with two separate types, and adds the three semantic slots v1 had no type for at all: area, move-in date and property feature. The frozen semantics of every type live in evaluation/results/_harness/constraint_schema_v2.py; this file is the structural contract only. The v1 file evaluation/benchmark/schema.json is UNCHANGED and still governs evaluation/benchmark/cases.jsonl.

case_id.description: Unique id inside the held-out set. The HO2- prefix keeps it disjoint from the v1 id space (^(CR|[A-H])[0-9]+$) so the two sets can never be silently merged.

schema_version.description: Pinned so a case authored under v2 can never be graded by a v1 predicate, or vice versa. The preflight fails on a mismatch (check M4).

task_category.description: The FROZEN stratum, written at authoring time. Never re-derived from a heuristic at scoring time. retrieval_hard = a retrieval turn that occupies the hard quota and must carry a deterministically decidable constraint; retrieval_soft = every other retrieval turn (open browse, and no-result probes whose constraints can only exercise the behaviour branch).

category.description: v1-compatible category, kept only so the existing runner code paths that switch on it keep working. task_category is the authoritative stratum.

user_id.description: Unique per case, so memory buckets cannot leak between cases.

user_text.description: REQUIRED for every user hard constraint. The VERBATIM span of user_query / conversation_history that states this condition. The preflight (check H6) re-runs the frozen normaliser on this span and fails the case unless it reproduces the stored value — so 'the user explicitly said this' is machine-checked rather than assumed.

granularity.description: area_match only. postcode_district compares the WHOLE outward district with exact equality, so N1 does not match N1C.

accept.description: area_match with granularity 'adjacent' only: the FROZEN list of area tokens that count as adjacent. Adjacency is never inferred at grading time; without this list the constraint is unjudgeable by construction.

hard_constraint_slots.description: The semantic slots this case declares. MUST equal the slots implied by expected_constraints (preflight check M5). An empty array is required, not optional, for a case with no hard constraint — 'declared none' and 'forgot to write it' must be distinguishable.

correct_completion.description: What a correct answer does for THIS task, written before any model request. Covers the no-result, unknown and partial-match branches where they apply.

allowed_evidence_sources.description: The only facts a judge may accept as support for this case. Structured fixture fields, the user's own figures, and the frozen derivation formulas — never a listing's free-text description.

reference_calculations.description: REQUIRED (non-null) for task_category 'calculation' — preflight check E2.

novelty_note.description: Why this case is not a reuse or a light rewrite of any of the 98 tuning cases.

fixture.description: Frozen tool evidence replayed for this case. REQUIRED whenever expected_tools is non-empty — preflight check E3, because unfrozen evidence is not reproducible across rounds.
